Great service and delicious food.
Oct 2026 • Solo
I really enjoyed my night here dining solo while my wife was a little sick. Spring rolls followed by pork bun cha. Both were outstanding. 
Service all night was friendly attentive and professional. The kindness of the staff was demonstrated when they insisted on sending ginger and honey tea home to my sick wife with her takeaway meal. 
Wine was wonderful too. 
Go for the view. Go again for the wonderful food and outstanding service. A high quality restaurant!!
